assessment.nobel_worthiness: IceCube opened high-energy neutrino astronomy, adding a genuinely new cosmic messenger and observational window.
assessment.attribution: Halzen was decisive in the scientific case and Spiering in realizing the detector and collaboration; both are credible representative credits.
assessment.maturity: The neutrino flux and astrophysical associations have made the field experimentally established after long, difficult detector work.
uncertainties: Credit for a large international observatory is necessarily selective.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Afterglow localization transformed gamma-ray bursts from mysterious transients into cosmological probes.
assessment.attribution: Costa and Frontera led the instrumental discovery route, while Kulkarni made seminal optical identifications and interpretation possible.
assessment.maturity: The cosmological origin and afterglow framework have been repeatedly confirmed over decades.
uncertainties: The broader satellite and follow-up teams contributed substantially.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Black-hole shadow imaging is an exceptional technical and observational achievement with fundamental physical reach.
assessment.attribution: Falcke articulated the shadow-imaging opportunity, Doeleman led its realization, and Zensus represents key very-long-baseline interferometry leadership.
assessment.maturity: Images of two black holes and extensive validation work establish the technique beyond a one-off result.
uncertainties: Attribution within the Event Horizon Telescope collaboration is unusually broad.
The interpretation remains dependent on detailed source modeling.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Optical lattice clocks have produced a major advance in timekeeping and precision tests, with far-reaching scientific uses.
assessment.attribution: Katori introduced the magic-wavelength lattice-clock concept and Ye made foundational experimental advances.
assessment.maturity: Independent laboratories now achieve extraordinary reproducibility and performance.
uncertainties: The eventual practical redefinition of the second is still a collective metrological process.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Silicon microstrip and pixel detectors are enabling measurement technologies that reshaped particle physics and spread widely beyond it.
assessment.attribution: The named scientists represent crucial detector concepts and their translation into usable high-resolution systems.
assessment.maturity: Their impact is long established across major experiments and applications.
uncertainties: The technological lineage spans many laboratories and may be difficult to delimit cleanly.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: The double pulsar provides an unusually clean strong-field laboratory for testing gravity and relativistic astrophysics.
assessment.attribution: Burgay and Lyne are central to discovery, and Kramer to the ensuing precision timing and physical tests.
assessment.maturity: A long timing baseline has made the system a durable and increasingly precise test bed.
uncertainties: Its scientific impact overlaps conceptually with earlier prize-recognized tests of general relativity.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: SASE X-ray free-electron lasers created an extraordinary new source for resolving ultrafast structural dynamics.
assessment.attribution: Saldin and Kim supplied essential theoretical foundations, while Pellegrini was central to turning the concept into a working facility.
assessment.maturity: Multiple operational facilities and a wide scientific user base demonstrate lasting impact.
uncertainties: Credit also belongs to a large accelerator-physics and engineering community.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: The discovery of the Kuiper Belt fundamentally revised the known architecture and formation history of the Solar System.
assessment.attribution: Jewitt and Luu made the defining first discovery and are cleanly identified with it.
assessment.maturity: The belt is now an extensively characterized population, confirmed by many surveys and missions.
uncertainties: Its importance is principally astronomical discovery rather than a new fundamental physical principle.
